method: Two serial batches, baseline/candidate/baseline/candidate. Same 100/1000-node legal fan-in graphs, production HTML, Ctrl background drag. Each group has 2 warmups, 12 lean samples by default, and a separate profile. Exact production file diff is asserted; loaded static resource hashes are compared, allowing only the workspace change. No timing alongside regression tests.

groups.method: Trusted Playwright gestures on production HTML/scripts. Fixed API and text-only synthetic documents. No replaced save implementation. Lean timings include event handler through first microtask, then first/second RAF arrival; 350ms follow-up window. Profile is a separate instrumented CDP trace, excluded from percentiles. Second RAF is a presentation opportunity, not physical display latency.
